state:
Goal `core-reflect-classinfo-and-1-more` (dossier), stage 2. `ClassInfo::attributes`, `::call`,
`::constant`, `::constants` and `::get` are complete: tests from both sides, three examples,
`about.md`, one attack and one recorded bench each. `Core\Reflect\ClassInfo` has its class card.
The `get` proofs found two bugs, both fixed: `get` read the slot itself, so it skipped a `get` hook
and returned an unwritten `lateinit` slot's storage state. It now goes through
`nvs_runtime::read_erased_property_owned`. Separately, `subject_of` no longer allocates the class name
on the success path, so `get` measures 0 allocations and `call` 7 (was 8). Items 6 to 16 of the goal
prose remain, and each owes an `about.md` too (goal prose § *The target*).

backlog: Compiled `nvs_object_slot_get` returns a `get` hook's fresh reference where its doc says the result is borrowed, so a hooked read of a counted value may leak one reference per read (not checked) — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs`'s `read_erased_property_hinted`.

An array read with a computed `uint` index allocates on every read; the same index `as int` does not (measured with `nvs run --count`, allocating site not checked). Owner not chosen: codegen's array-read lowering is the likely home.

`constants` on a subclass lists the parent's `private` constants (`KEY` on `Child extends Base`). The card says "every inherited one"; whether a `private` one is inherited is not stated in `rule:core-classes/reflect` (not checked against ADR 0019).
`ClassInfo::set`, `::methods`, `::properties` and the rest of goal prose items 6 to 16 — goal prose § *The target*.
